_note: Effect-specific modifiers from the individual effect descriptions in DC Adventures chapter 6. Same schema as modifiers.json.

extras.name: Cumulative
extras.summary: Further failed checks add to the target's conditions.

extras.name: Extra Condition
extras.summary: Imposes an additional condition per degree.

extras.name: Progressive
extras.summary: Worsens each round until the target resists.

extras.name: Concentration
extras.summary: Keep forcing new checks with a standard action after one hit.

flaws.name: Limited Degree
flaws.summary: Stops at two degrees of effect.

flaws.name: Instant Recovery
flaws.summary: The target recovers automatically at the end of its turn.

extras.name: Broad
extras.summary: Can weaken any trait from a broad set, one at a time.

extras.name: Simultaneous
extras.summary: A Broad Weaken affects all its traits at once.

extras.name: Progressive
extras.summary: Keeps draining each round until resisted.

extras.name: Concentration
extras.summary: Keep forcing new checks after one hit.

extras.name: Precise
extras.summary: Choose which of several traits to reduce.

extras.name: Broad
extras.summary: Counters any effect with a broad descriptor.

extras.name: Simultaneous
extras.summary: Counters every matching effect at once.

extras.name: Effortless
extras.summary: Retrying after a bad failure needs no extra effort.

extras.name: Precise
extras.summary: Pick which effects to counter.

extras.name: Concentration
extras.summary: Countered effects stay off while you concentrate.

extras.name: Randomize
extras.summary: Targeted effects go out of control instead of shutting off.

extras.name: Sustained
extras.summary: Keeping effects suppressed takes only a free action.

extras.name: Aquatic
extras.summary: Also move underwater at Flight rank minus 2.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.summary: Keeps you aloft (or lowers you gently) even if you are knocked out.

flaws.name: Wings
flaws.summary: Flies on wings that can be bound or injured.

flaws.name: Platform
flaws.summary: Flies on a disc, board or similar platform.

flaws.name: Gliding
flaws.summary: Glide on air currents; you must come down after a limited distance.

flaws.name: Levitation
flaws.summary: Only rise and sink straight up and down.

extras.name: Accurate
extras.summary: Teleport to places you can't sense.

extras.name: Change Direction
extras.summary: Change facing on arrival.

extras.name: Change Velocity
extras.summary: Arrive at rest.

extras.name: Easy
extras.summary: No penalties for extended teleports.

extras.name: Extended
extras.summary: Make long-distance teleports with two move actions.

extras.name: Portal
extras.summary: Open a gateway others can step through.

extras.name: Turnabout
extras.summary: Teleport, act, and teleport back.

flaws.name: Limited to Extended
flaws.summary: Only extended teleports; needs the Extended extra.

flaws.name: Medium
flaws.summary: Travel only between places where your medium (wires, shadows, water) exists.

extras.name: Movable
extras.summary: Move your creations around.

extras.name: Stationary
extras.summary: Creations can hang unsupported in the air.

extras.name: Tether
extras.summary: Stay connected to your creations.

extras.name: Precise
extras.summary: Detailed, precise creations.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.summary: Objects remain until destroyed or you dismiss them.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.summary: Objects last until destroyed; you can't dismiss, repair or alter them.

flaws.name: Proportional
flaws.summary: Volume and Toughness together share your Create rank.

extras.name: Damaging
extras.summary: Can strike targets directly.

extras.name: Precise
extras.summary: Fine manipulation at a distance.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.summary: Held objects stay put even if you can't keep concentrating.

extras.name: Sustained
extras.summary: Holding objects in place takes only a free action.

flaws.name: Limited Direction
flaws.summary: Move things only along one path, such as toward or away from you.

flaws.name: Limited Material
flaws.summary: Move only one kind of material, like metal or water.

extras.name: Restorative
extras.summary: Also restores weakened traits.

extras.name: Persistent
extras.summary: Heals even incurable harm.

extras.name: Energizing
extras.summary: Also clears fatigue and exhaustion, which you take on yourself.

extras.name: Resurrection
extras.summary: Bring back the recently dead with a DC 20 check.

extras.name: Stabilize
extras.summary: Stabilizes the dying automatically, no check needed.

flaws.name: Empathic
flaws.summary: You take on the conditions you cure.

flaws.name: Temporary
flaws.summary: Healed damage returns after an hour.

extras.name: Persistent
extras.summary: Regenerates incurable damage too.

flaws.name: Source
flaws.summary: Only works with access to a particular source.

extras.name: Active
extras.summary: Minions act fully each round.

extras.name: Controlled
extras.summary: Minions have no free will.

extras.name: Heroic
extras.summary: Summoned allies aren't minions.

extras.name: Horde
extras.summary: Summon all your minions at once.

extras.name: Mental Link
extras.summary: Telepathic link with your minions.

extras.name: Multiple Minions
extras.summary: Each application doubles the number of minions.

extras.name: Variable Type
extras.summary: Summon different minions.

extras.name: Sacrifice
extras.summary: Spend a hero point to shift an effect onto a minion.

flaws.name: Attitude
flaws.summary: Summoned minions are indifferent or unfriendly and won't simply obey.

extras.name: Cumulative
extras.summary: Further successes dig deeper.

extras.name: Effortless
extras.summary: Retry without extra effort.

extras.name: Sensory Link
extras.summary: Share the subject's senses.

flaws.name: Limited by Language
flaws.summary: Only understand minds that share your language.

flaws.name: Limited to Emotions
flaws.summary: Read only feelings, not thoughts or memories.

flaws.name: Limited to Sensory Link
flaws.summary: Only share senses; you can't read thoughts.

flaws.name: Limited to Surface Thoughts
flaws.summary: Can't go deeper than surface thoughts.

extras.name: Normal Strength
extras.summary: Keep full Strength while shrunk.

extras.name: Atomic
extras.summary: At Shrinking 20, slip between atoms to pass through solid objects.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.summary: Always on; can't be switched off or boosted with extra effort (Sustained made Permanent, +0).

extras.name: Reflect
extras.summary: Bounce attacks you are immune to back at the attacker.

extras.name: Redirect
extras.summary: Send reflected attacks at another target in range; needs Reflect.

flaws.name: Limited to Half Effect
flaws.summary: Halves the effect instead of ignoring it.

extras.name: Independent
extras.summary: Illusions take only a free action to maintain.

extras.name: Selective
extras.summary: Choose who perceives the illusion.

flaws.name: Limited to One Subject
flaws.summary: Only one subject at a time sees the illusion.

extras.name: Affects Others
extras.summary: Grant concealment to others.

extras.name: Attack
extras.summary: Impose concealment on a target.

flaws.name: Blending
flaws.summary: Only works while standing still against a background.

flaws.name: Partial
flaws.summary: Partial rather than total concealment.

flaws.name: Passive
flaws.summary: Drops as soon as you attack or make an effect check.

extras.name: Selective
extras.summary: Vary conditions within the area.

extras.name: Permanent
extras.summary: Stay at your enlarged size all the time.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.summary: Stay insubstantial until you choose to turn solid.

extras.name: Progressive
extras.summary: Pass through each lower form in turn to reach higher ones.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.summary: You're always insubstantial and can't turn solid.

flaws.name: Absent Strength
flaws.summary: Rank 1 only: no effective Strength in that form.

flaws.name: Permanent
flaws.summary: Always on; can't be switched off or boosted with extra effort.

flaws.name: Reduced Trait
flaws.summary: Another trait drops; worth the points that trait loses.

extras.name: Rapid
extras.summary: Communicate ten times faster per rank.

flaws.name: Type
flaws.summary: Comprehend only a broad or narrow type of subject.

extras.name: Continuous
extras.summary: Limbs stay until you dismiss them, even if you are knocked out.

extras.name: Projection
extras.summary: Limbs are projections, so harm aimed at them does nothing.

flaws.name: Acrobatics Check Required
flaws.summary: Leap distance depends on a DC 10 Acrobatics check.

flaws.name: Full Power
flaws.summary: Every leap is at full distance.

extras.name: Luck
extras.summary: Each rank grants a rank of the Luck advantage.

extras.name: Metamorph
extras.summary: Each rank adds an alternate set of traits to switch into.

flaws.name: Sustained
flaws.summary: Can be switched on and off and boosted with extra effort.

flaws.name: Limited to One Type
flaws.summary: Speeds up only physical or only mental tasks.

flaws.name: Limited to One Task
flaws.summary: Speeds up only one particular task.

extras.name: No Conduit
extras.summary: Sensory effects can't reach you through the remote point.

extras.name: Simultaneous
extras.summary: Use your own senses and the remote ones at once.

flaws.name: Medium
flaws.summary: Sense only places where your medium (mirrors, flames) exists.

extras.name: Action
extras.summary: Reconfigure faster: move action, free action or reaction.

flaws.name: Slow
flaws.summary: Reconfigure only outside action time.

extras.name: Mobility
extras.summary: Sacrifice one extra attack to move an additional 5 feet (no more than half a move action in a round).

extras.name: Quick Combo
extras.summary: Each rank applies a Combo Element to a qualified maneuver or power when used with the additional attacks.

extras.name: Quickened Charge
extras.summary: Once per round spend one additional attack with a charge, making the charge a free action (all attacks must be Close range).

flaws.name: Activation (Move Action)
flaws.summary: Using Extra Attacks takes an entire round.

flaws.name: Chain
flaws.summary: Each attack depends on the one before it: if any misses, the series ends and the power is denied for the round.

flaws.name: Declining
flaws.summary: Every extra attack after the first suffers a cumulative -5 to attack.

flaws.name: Dispersed
flaws.summary: Every extra attack after the first suffers a cumulative -4 to the initiative result.

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.summary: Restricts the power to specified types of attacks or powers.

extras.name: Fortunate
extras.summary: Extra effort needs only one contributor (the controlling one) to pay the hero point.

extras.name: Fractioned
extras.summary: Works with absent contributors at reduced rank (+1) or full potency if at least half are present (+2).

extras.name: Interchangeable
extras.summary: Contributors may change the controlling contributor without turning the power off (all must pass a Will check).

extras.name: Leech
extras.summary: Each rank lets one character stand in as a temporary contributor by losing access to as many power points.

extras.name: True Control
extras.summary: The controlling contributor uses only their own abilities instead of the average of all contributors.

flaws.name: Difficult
flaws.summary: Extra effort requires every contributor to pass a Will check (DC 10 + rank).

flaws.name: Focused
flaws.summary: One contributor must always be the effect's focus and always present for its use.

flaws.name: Power Loss
flaws.summary: Each contributor loses one individual power while taking part (-2 per rank: all other powers).

flaws.name: Resistible
flaws.summary: Contributors may refuse activation through opposed Will checks.

flaws.name: Short-Circuit
flaws.summary: Removing a contributor also inflicts a harmful effect (built on half the effect's points) on the others.

flaws.name: Stationary
flaws.summary: No contributor may move from their location while the effect operates.
